R608.note: Secure: true set on the cookie literal; the added HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict are stated plainly with the Lax fallback named, and block no legitimate same-site login flow shown in the case.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes both tenantId and the pre-built %term% pattern; tenant filter, contains-style match, async List<Product> return and empty-term behaviour are all unchanged.

R610.note: Correctly identifies that store.New is not a rotation on CookieStore and instead drops every decoded pre-auth value before writing the authenticated session; discarding pre-login state is the intended effect and is stated, login path and Options untouched.

R611.note: Template plus argument separation and a control-char/line-separator encoder close the log-forging vector; the backslash-to-u005c encoding is stated (though it does change how a legitimate DOMAIN-backslash-user name renders in the log) and blocks no caller.

R612.note: parserBuilder().setSigningKey().parseClaimsJws() verifies the signature and rejects alg none; the new required Key constructor dependency and the swallow-and-continue-unauthenticated handling for bad tokens are both stated plainly.

R613.note: eval() is removed for a closed arithmetic grammar with no path to code execution, but the new evaluator rejects PHP arithmetic the original accepted (%, **, exponent and hex literals), adds an unstated 200-character cap, and returns float where the original returned int for integer expressions (an unstated result-type change).

R614.note: Substring test replaced with a length check plus subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; returns true only on exact equality and false for empty or partial values, as the contract requires.

R615.note: self.get_object() routes the lookup through the owner-scoped get_queryset() and check_object_permissions(); staff still reach every invoice, non-staff get 404 for both missing and foreign invoices, response body unchanged.

R616.note: CGI escapeHTML on both interpolated values at the sink neutralizes markup in the h2 text context; static output unchanged (minor inaccuracy: with charset utf-8 escapeHTML does not encode the apostrophe, which is harmless in this text context).

R617.note: Build fails: the check reads message.UserId but ChatMessage exposes AuthorUserId (and the write-up treats GetMessageAsync as an assumed addition when ChatMessageStore.cs already defines it), so the fix as shipped does not compile; the intended design also turns a delete of a nonexistent id from silent success into a HubException, which is stated.

R618.note: Removing the is_staff widening makes list() enforce the same owner-only rule IsTicketOwner already applied on detail actions; per the documented policy staff had no legitimate list access to other customers' tickets, and the change is stated plainly.
